headline: Canucks activate Filip Chytil from IR, expected to return vs. Rangers
take:
Daily Faceoff reported that the Canucks activated Filip Chytil from injured reserve and put defenseman Guillaume Brisebois on IR in his place. Chytil did play Friday against the Rangers, the team that drafted him in the first round in 2017 and traded him to Vancouver in the J.T. Miller deal. It was not a happy return: a 5-1 loss, the Canucks' seventh straight, and a goalie's pass into his skates that turned into a Rangers goal.

The bigger issue is what's around him. Vancouver is 3-17-1 with 40% of the expected goals, our measure of chance quality, and has allowed 15 more goals than those chances say it should have. Chytil has no goals and two assists in eight games, and the Canucks have had just 25% of the 5-on-5 expected goals with him on the ice. A healthy Chytil is a real NHL center. This team needs more than one.
